name: abstain-existing-nn-tile-output-order
hypothesis: The selected store order already exists in the supplied NN baseline. After each K loop, Llibxsmm_478 and Llibxsmm_70c, the code extracts ZA0 and ZA1 and stores their outputs before extracting and storing ZA2 and ZA3. This is an alias of the measured baseline, not a distinct source change. The recommendation also misstates the tile dimensions: at 16 FP32 lanes, four ZA.S tiles hold 32×32 outputs. ZA0/ZA1 cover its first 16 rows; ZA2/ZA3 cover its next 16 rows. The latter stores use x9=C_tile+32768 bytes, equal to 16 row strides. The second compute block starts at C_tile+65536 bytes, or 32 rows. Each column-panel advance is 128 bytes, or 32 columns, so the existing traversal processes 64×32 blocks, not 64×64. Implementing a different traversal would replace the selected experiment. No edits, tools, tests or measurements were performed. Retain the unchanged NN incumbent; no performance gain or goal completion is established.
